angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 584,388 km at 82.35 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.1436 +/- 0.0100 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 82.35 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.84 +/- 0.09 solar radii from Otegi et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1062 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract): 584,388 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.94 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Otegi et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1062 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5328 +/- 56 K from Otegi et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1062 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Otegi et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1062 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1062.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.563, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1062 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 V, from Otegi et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1062 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Otegi et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1062 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.27446, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1062 (pscomppars): age 2.5 Gyr, from Otegi et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1062 (pscomppars): rotation period 21.8 d, from Otegi et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1062 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.13 km/s, from Otegi et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...653A.105O/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
